steps.content:
10:30, February ■■, N.F. 115
DisSea Monitoring Station, FAC
A massive machine hums in the center of the room.
Around it, dozens of MBCC medics and FAC researchers are busying at their stations.
They're supporting the person slumbering within the machine—the MBCC Chief, now taking a deep dive in another Illusory Moon tide.
The efficient team works together seamlessly, clearly well-trained for their job. Yet despite their professionalism, their faces are still tinged with apprehension and concern.

steps.speaker: MBCC Medic
steps.content: Can this... really help the Chief?

steps.speaker: FAC Researcher
steps.content: In what regard?

steps.speaker: FAC Researcher
steps.content: If you're talking about resolving the anomalies or finding crucial clues for your Chief, then the answer is no.

steps.speaker: FAC Researcher
steps.content: But it can monitor vitals, hormone levels, M-Value fluctuations, a dozen parameters. If anything spikes beyond the threshold, the embedded Hypercube inhibitors will kick in and pull your Chief out of the illusion.

steps.speaker: FAC Researcher
steps.content: This project took three research teams one full year. The budget was astronomical. I won't claim it's foolproof, but at the very least, we've done everything in our power to minimize the risks.

steps.speaker: MBCC Medic
steps.content: Thanks for all that hard work.

steps.speaker: FAC Researcher
steps.content: At least we don't have to risk our lives in the DisSea... But honestly, as dangerous as it is, I still envy your Chief.

steps.speaker: FAC Researcher
steps.content: The Expedition Team... they're the greatest heroes in human history. I read so much about them as a kid. Their stories inspired me to become a scientist.

steps.speaker: FAC Researcher
steps.content: If possible, I'd really love to meet them in person...
[Scene Transition] CG

steps.speaker: Black-Haired Woman
steps.content: Alright, open your mouth.
The woman before you leans in with a gentle smile.

steps.speaker: Black-Haired Woman
steps.content: Don't worry. Everything's fine now.
Her voice is kind and gentle. You open your mouth without thinking.
After checking your mouth, she gently brushes a hand across your cheek and parts your eyelids.

steps.speaker: Black-Haired Woman
steps.content: No bleeding in the mucosa... Alright, let's check your torso next. Don't worry, it won't hurt.
The woman takes out a stethoscope and puts it on, tucking a few stray strands of hair behind her ears.
She unbuttons your jacket and warms the chest piece in her palm before pressing it against your chest.

The process feels slow and tedious. You don't dare move, and the people around you seem to be holding their breath. Only when she withdraws the metal probe and removes the stethoscope do you finally voice your question.

steps.speaker: Black-Haired Woman
steps.content: Hmm? No, I'm not.

steps.speaker: Black-Haired Woman
steps.content: Compared to Banyan, I'm not even fit to be her intern.

steps.speaker: Black-Haired Woman
steps.content: But when you spend enough time at sea, you tend to pick up a few useful skills.
The woman puts her medical tools away, but her gaze never leaves you for a second, and she still wears that gentle smile.

steps.speaker: Black-Haired Woman
steps.content: Back to you, little guide. Your body is healthy. At least from what I can tell with the tools on board.

steps.speaker: Black-Haired Woman
steps.content: ...After going through something so horrific, you're still standing here, unharmed. It's nothing short of a miracle.
Upon hearing that, the hushed crowd around you erupts into a small cheer.

steps.speaker: Captain Edmond
steps.content: And it's not just one miracle, Shin. Pylgia made it back in one piece too.
You follow the crewman's finger and see a familiar figure. Her hair is still damp, but the tattered diving suit and grotesque limb growths from your memory are gone.
Meeting your gaze, Pylgia smiles and waves. After all you've been through together, just one look is enough. You have no doubt this is the Pylgia you know.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Don't worry, Pylgia's in good shape. Ragnar has been treated too. He hasn't regained consciousness yet, but his vitals have stabilized.

steps.speaker: Vikmar
steps.content: Too bad Dale didn't make it back...

steps.speaker: Captain Edmond
steps.content: No one will forget their sacrifice, but we have more important things to do.

steps.speaker: Laura
steps.content: All collectors have been recovered and the data analyzed. Time's running out... We should start the salvage operation immediately before this tidal cycle ends.
They're talking over each other, but based on their words and Pylgia's presence, you're fairly certain that this is a time node adjacent to the previous singularity.
It's clear that they're planning a dive for some kind of salvage operation, and your heart sinks at the realization.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: We're close to the target coordinates...
The woman called Shin finishes packing her tools and stands up. The noisy crowd falls silent the moment she speaks, waiting for her orders.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: We stick to the plan. Vikmar and I will deploy the salvage equipment. Sigmund and Laura will stay at the Abyss entrance to assist us.

steps.speaker: Captain Edmond
steps.content: Wait, this is a risky mission... Pylgia, you know these waters better than anyone. If you go with Shin, we'll feel more at ease...
All eyes turn to Pylgia. She frowns slightly and opens her mouth to speak, but the woman dressed as a researcher doesn't notice her hesitation and jumps in.

steps.speaker: Laura
steps.content: With your and Shin's experience, I'm sure you can handle whatever comes up. I know it's a lot to ask, sending you back down after you just barely escaped with your life, but...

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: It's fine, I can go. But...
Everyone looks at you in surprise. Clearly they weren't expecting an objection. Perhaps this isn't the kind of thing their guide would do.
The middle-aged researcher looks annoyed that her important discussion was interrupted.

steps.speaker: Laura
steps.content: The Perishing Star salvage mission is critical. You can say our entire Deep Dive unit was created for this sole purpose. Now that the target is right here, there's no reason to turn back...

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Laura...
Shin raises a hand, stopping the researcher. She then turns to you and asks in that same, gentle tone, without any sign of impatience.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Can you tell us why? Why shouldn't we go down?
You can tell that she's treating you like a child.
Noting the crew's mixed expressions, you take a deep breath.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's extremely dangerous under the sea. There's a terrifying entity in the Abyss, something beyond our comprehension. It can twist the entire environment and inflict irreversible mental contamination on anything that enters its domain.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't know how to fight it... I don't think humanity has the technology or means to deal with something like that. We only made it back alive because...
You glance toward Pylgia in her human form and swallow the words on the tip of your tongue.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Because we were lucky. But I don't think we'll be that lucky again.
The crew falls silent, including Shin. After a long moment, the researcher named Laura speaks up begrudgingly.

steps.speaker: Laura
steps.content: ...Pylgia, is it true?
Pylgia doesn't speak, just nods silently.
The crew stirs.
Shin's eyes are downcast. She seems to be pondering the current situation. The crew's gazes rest on her, their hopeful inquiry carrying the inescapable weight of responsibility.
But that burden doesn't make her hesitate for long. She looks up, pale blue eyes shining, and gives her answer with her usual gentle smile.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: I believe in our guide.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: The research matters. But the fact is, Dale and the others are gone. If the Abyss is as dangerous as what we just heard, the risk of going there is beyond our control. Even if we could bring something back... I... I cannot accept results paid for in lives.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Our little guide and Pylgia are our companions. When it comes to the dangers in the Abyss, they have more say than any of us. I think we can all agree on that, right?
Shin glances around the room. The crew's silence serves as their answer.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: We've already retrieved the collectors. That's more than enough for now. So...

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: It's time we go home.
The crew exchange looks. This isn't what they had hoped for.
In the end, it's the captain-like man who breaks the silence.

steps.speaker: Captain Edmond
steps.content: What are you standing around for?

steps.speaker: Captain Edmond
steps.content: Back to your posts! Turn the ship around. We're...

steps.speaker: Captain Edmond
steps.content: Going home!
